note: 本页讲解与练习为本站原创编写，例句取自本课课文。建议先学完这里再去听课文，听的时候你会「对上号」。想系统深入，可翻《剑桥中级英语语法》对应 Unit。

sections.heading: 什么时候用
sections.body: 说过去发生、已经结束的事，就用一般过去时。讲故事、写日记、复述经历，都是它。本课整篇课文就是一段过去时叙事——下面这两句，一会儿你会在课文里听到：

examples.en: Last week I went to the theatre.
I had a very good seat.

sections.heading: 动词怎么变
sections.body: 规则动词在词尾加 -ed；不规则动词没有规律，要单独记。本课出现的动词：

examples.en: go → went, have → had, get → got
sit → sat, say → said, hear → heard

sections.heading: 否定：did not + 动词原形
sections.body: 过去时的否定用 did not（didn't）加动词原形。注意：did 已经表示过去了，后面的动词要变回原形，不能再用过去式。

examples.en: They did not pay any attention.

sections.heading: 疑问：Did + 主语 + 动词原形
sections.body: 问过去的事用 Did 开头，动词同样用原形。这一课课前的问题就是现成的例子：

examples.en: Why did the writer complain to the people behind him?
examples.zh: 作者为什么要抱怨坐在他身后的人？

sections.heading: could：can 的过去式
sections.body: can 的过去式是 could，否定是 could not（couldn't），后面接动词原形。

examples.en: I could not hear the actors.
examples.zh: 我听不见演员们说的话。

examples.en: In the end, I could not bear it.

exercises.prompt: Last week I ___ to the theatre. (go)
exercises.explain: go 是不规则动词，过去式是 went。

exercises.prompt: I got very angry and ___ round. (turn)
exercises.explain: turn 是规则动词，直接加 -ed → turned。
过去的否定：did not + 动词原形 pay。故事发生在上星期，用 do not 不对；were not 后面不能直接接动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 'It's none of your business,' the young man ___ rudely. (say)
exercises.explain: say 的过去式是 said，读音是 /sed/。
didn't 已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形 enjoy，不能再用过去式 enjoyed。
问过去的事：Did + 主语 + 动词原形。回答是 No, he didn't. —— 身后有人一直在大声说话。

topics.title: 陈述句语序
topics.subtitle: Word order: verb + object; place and time

sections.heading: 动词和宾语不分家
sections.body: 英语里动词和它的宾语要紧挨着，中间不能插进别的词。「非常喜欢这出戏」不能逐字翻成 like very much this play——very much 要放到宾语后面去：

examples.en: I like this play very much.
examples.note: ✗ I like very much this play.
hear + a word，动词紧跟宾语

sections.heading: 先说地点，再说时间
sections.body: 「去了哪儿 + 什么时候」：地点在前，时间在后。这正是课文第一句话的骨架，听的时候留意一下：

examples.en: I went to the theatre last week.
examples.note: ✗ I went last week to the theatre.

sections.heading: 时间词也可以提到句首
sections.body: 想强调时间，可以把时间词整个搬到句子最前面。课文开头就是这么写的：

examples.en: Last week I went to the theatre.

exercises.prompt: 连词成句：上星期我去了剧院。
answers: I went to the theatre last week
last week I went to the theatre
exercises.explain: 地点 to the theatre 在前，时间 last week 在后；时间词也可以提到句首。

options: I like very much this play.
I like this play very much.
exercises.explain: 动词 like 和宾语 this play 要挨着，very much 放在宾语后面。

exercises.prompt: 连词成句：他们在大声说话。
exercises.explain: 副词 loudly 放在动词后面，说明「怎么说话」。
动词 read 和宾语 the letter 之间不能插 quickly。

exercises.prompt: 连词成句：我听不见演员们说的话。
answers: I could not hear the actors
exercises.explain: could not + 动词原形 hear，后面紧跟宾语 the actors。

options: We arrived at the theatre at seven o'clock.
We arrived at seven o'clock at the theatre.
exercises.explain: 先地点 at the theatre，再时间 at seven o'clock。

exercises.prompt: 连词成句：她每天都去健身房。
answers: She goes to the gym every day
exercises.explain: 地点 to the gym 在前，时间 every day 在后。
